name: Modified WFNS Grade

version.label: Modified WFNS (Sano et al. 2015)
version.detail: Proposed by the WFNS Cerebrovascular Disease & Treatment Committee with the Japan Neurosurgical Society. Grades by GCS alone; focal deficit is not used.

reviewStatus: Content drafted from primary sources; pending independent clinician review before clinical release.
purpose: GCS-only SAH grading intended to improve prognostic separation of grades II and III.

insights.text: Not interchangeable with the original WFNS. Always label which version is reported.

limitations: Fewer external validation studies than the original WFNS.
commonErrors: Reporting as 'WFNS' without stating the modified version.
Using a GCS with a non-testable component.

sources.citation: Sano H, Satoh A, Murayama Y, et al. Modified World Federation of Neurosurgical Societies subarachnoid hemorrhage grading system. World Neurosurg. 2015;83(5):801-807.

guide.what: A GCS-only version of the WFNS grade: 15 = I, 14 = II, 13 = III, 7–12 = IV, 3–6 = V.
guide.whenUseful: Where a GCS-only grade is preferred, or the original Grade II/III distinction is unreliable.
guide.howToCalculate: Obtain a full GCS and map it to the grade.
guide.clinicalContext: Use the version your unit and the relevant literature use, and label it.
